svg.title: SwinIR-Light linear pipeline left to right
svg.desc: SwinIR-Light architecture: LR input → Conv3x3 → RSTB1 → RSTB2 → RSTB3 → RSTB4 → Conv3x3 → PixelShuffle → Conv3x3 → HR output, all left to right in sequence.
